733450101.text: Well, why are you back? Did you get the door slammed on you by our great Vijnanapati? I'll have you know that he doesn't compromise so easily with the Pari.

733450102.text: You should just leave. And don't even think of getting anything more from me!

733450103.text: Pfft! You spilled the beans without our help every time, though!

733450106.text: You tell Pyrrho of the Great Songs and Nasejuna's betrayal.

733450107.text: Nonsense. Utter nonsense! Our Vijnanapati is the most scholarly man I know. He would not band together with those defiled beings!

733450108.text: I'll bet you're just trying to mask your failure by sowing dissent.

733450109.text: Nice try, but your story's way out there. No way I'd fall for that!

733450110.text: Ugh... C'mon, we gotta think. Don't we have those notes that Nasejuna gave us?

733450111.text: It should still have Nasejuna's notes. Pyrrho should believe us if we give those to him!

733450112.text: What notes are these? You really love those tricks of yours, don't you?

733450113.text: You give Rene's Investigation Notes to Pyrrho.

733450114.text: This... This is indeed the great Vijnanapati's handwriting...

733450115.text: It truly was a once-in-a-lifetime thing that we gained such a knowledgeable leader, and yet he turned his back on our duties and threw his lot with the followers of the dark hollow...

733450116.text: *sigh* You may not know this, but we have struggled against the followers of the dark hollow for hundreds of years.

733450117.text: You could say that they are akin to our shadow, always attempting to taint our heritage. I have no doubt that the fall of our order to its present state cannot be separated from their plots.

733450118.text: But I never thought that this time, even our leader would be... Ah, a plague upon our house, this is!

733450119.text: No doubt Nasejuna has gone with those impure villains and now skulks with them in the shadows.

733450120.text: In the past, he followed Elder Aryadeva to the Akademiya, and upon returning, he was absorbed with those ancient documents.

733450121.text: We were people who emphasized praxis, and we found ourselves without a scholar like him for many years. I had thought that he would lead us to reform, but...
